title: US quarterly equity expiration (June 2027 triple witching) — displaced off the third Friday to Thursday by the Juneteenth closure
source: EST: TWO Cboe primary surfaces re-fetched direct 2026-09-05 by the juneteenth-market-closure-2027-06-18 initial research, plus a measured tape precedent. (1) cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement (HTTP 200, 536,888 bytes) carries a live Cboe S&P 500 Variance futures row rendered `"VA/M7", " - ", "2027-06-17"` with a real daily settlement price against it (319.25). (2) The machine-readable endpoint www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200, 1,731 bytes) independently returns `VA,VA/M7,2027-06-17,319.25`. WHY THAT DATES THE EXPIRATION: every other VA row on both surfaces is the third Friday of its contract month — VA/U6 2026-09-18, VA/V6 2026-10-16, VA/X6 2026-11-20, VA/Z6 2026-12-18, VA/F7 2027-01-15, VA/G7 2027-02-19, VA/Z7 2027-12-17, all verified third Fridays by weekday arithmetic this session. VA/M7 is the single exception, and it lands exactly one session earlier than June 2027's third Friday (2027-06-18), which is the Juneteenth closure. INDEPENDENT ARITHMETIC CROSS-CHECK on the same two surfaces: VX/K7 settles 2027-05-18, a Tuesday, which is 2027-06-17 minus 30 calendar days — VIX futures AM-settle exactly 30 days before the SPX expiration they reference, and the same rule reproduces VX/H7 2027-03-17 -> 2027-04-16 and VX/J7 2027-04-21 -> 2027-05-21 against unadjusted third Fridays. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep; `OCC:` is the prefix this class promotes under and the evidence is already at that standard. Checked 2026-09-05
notes: PROPOSED by the juneteenth-market-closure-2027-06-18 initial research (2026-09-05), one session before that closure and therefore inside the deterministic screen's +/-5-day adjacency window. This entry exists because the fomc-2027-06-09 lane explicitly wanted it and could not source it: its note records that two Cboe settlement URLs returned 404 on 2026-09-05, so the moved expiration date was deliberately left unfiled and registered instead as FT-fomc-2027-06-09-2. Both surfaces were reachable to the Juneteenth lane the same day, so the entry is now filed on evidence rather than inference. THE MECHANIC, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: 2026 is the same displacement one year earlier (2026-06-19 was both Juneteenth and June's third Friday), and the 2026 tape settles what a rule text would only assert. Mean relative volume across eight large caps (AAPL MSFT JPM XOM JNJ PG KO WMT, each session's volume over the median of its prior 20) was 2.25 on Thursday 2026-06-18 against 1.01-1.09 on every other session of that week; the 45 non-displaced quarterly witchings from 2015 to 2026-03 run min 1.40 / p25 1.91 / median 2.20 / p75 2.53 / max 3.63, and the day BEFORE a witching runs near 1.10. The witching signature moved wholesale to the Thursday. Note that SPY's own volume does NOT show this (2026-06-18 relvol 1.57 against a June-witching history whose expiry-day and day-before medians are both near 1.3) — single names carry the closing-auction rebalance flow, the index ETF does not, and a later session should not re-run this test on SPY and conclude the displacement is unproven. WHAT IT IS ADJACENT TO: this session is a full equity AND full fixed-income day (SIFMA's published 2027 US schedule attaches no early close to Juneteenth, unlike Good Friday 2027, whose Thursday 2027-03-25 carries a 2:00 p.m. ET bond close), it is 6 sessions after fomc-2027-06-09 (high, estimate) and 4 after boj-decision-2027-06-11 (medium, estimate), and it is followed by a 3-calendar-day gap to the next session, Monday 2027-06-21. Impact LOW: no house playbook is opex- or calendar-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped 2026-09-05 for holiday|juneteenth|closure|half-day|early close|witching|expiration week, zero hits in both). Estimate widens caution only; promote on an OCC or Cboe expiration-calendar primary, which this session could not reach directly (theocc.com 403, cdn.cboe.com expiration-calendar PDF 403, optionseducation.org renders its calendar client-side).
